chunks: And as for the right of your hand, it is that you do not stretch it toward that which is unlawful for you.
ai.seo_question: What is the right of the hand according to Imam Ali's Risalat al-Huquq?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin frames the 'right of the hand' not merely as a prohibition of forbidden acts, but as a positive discipline of channeling physical agency toward halal ends, reflecting the Shia emphasis on holistic self-accountability (muhasaba). This concept aligns with the broader theological principle that every bodily member has a specific right (haqq) over the individual, requiring conscious stewardship of one's faculties in accordance with divine law.
